justification: Inspected src/main/java/org/apache/commons/io/file/SimplePathVisitor.java, src/main/java/org/apache/commons/io/file/NoopPathVisitor.java, and src/main/java/org/apache/commons/io/file/CountingPathVisitor.java. SimplePathVisitor is only 105 lines long and contains 3 constructors, 1 overridden method (visitFileFailed), and a small nested AbstractBuilder with 1 field and 1 setter; it acts as a narrow base for Path visitors and only centralizes visitFileFailed customization. The class does not show the multiple independent responsibilities, large method set, or low-cohesion structure expected for insufficient modularization.
